session_1.speaker: Alex
session_1.text: Hi Jordan! I just moved to Seattle and started at Contoso as a platform engineer.

session_1.speaker: Jordan
session_1.text: Welcome! Seattle is great. What stack are you using at Contoso?

session_1.speaker: Alex
session_1.text: We standardize on PostgreSQL for new services. I also run a homelab with MySQL for legacy apps.

session_1.speaker: Jordan
session_1.text: Nice. I'm more of a MongoDB person for side projects.

session_2.speaker: Alex
session_2.text: Update: Contoso migrated the payments service from MySQL to PostgreSQL last month.

session_2.speaker: Jordan
session_2.text: Did you keep anything on MySQL?

session_2.speaker: Alex
session_2.text: Only my homelab legacy apps still use MySQL. Work projects are PostgreSQL-only now.

session_2.speaker: Jordan
session_2.text: Got it. Still planning the Japan trip for October?

session_2.speaker: Alex
session_2.text: Yes — Tokyo and Kyoto, October 12 through October 22.
